messages:
emma: FYI I spotted a bunch of production requests routed from eu-west -> us-east at ~11:05 despite region-pin=eu config. Noticed elevated tail latency and some 502s.
raj: ugh. any correlation with the NAT pool changes earlier?
emma: timeline: 11:00 autopatch rolled NAT egress pool update (infra changelist), 11:04 DNS responses for region.myapp.redwood returned us-east IPs for some clients.
sophia: do we have dig/trace logs for the failing clients? could be stale DNS resolver TTLs + aggressive loadbalancer fallback.
emma: grabbed a sample: client resolver got TTL 30s, but the edge LB health checks failed when source IP didn't match expected egress range. The LB then rebalanced to us-east fallback.
oliver: so two levers: (1) DNS TTL and routing policy, (2) source IP-based LB affinity. If NAT changed, health checks see new IPs and mark backend unhealthy.
raj: config: our geo-dns uses latency-based weighted routing with region-pin override. Region-pin should bypass latency routing; maybe fallback policy kicks in when LB signals unhealthy.
sophia: can you paste the relevant LB health check log?
emma: pasted snippet from lb logs: 
```
[11:04:12] healthcheck fail from 34.201.x.x (not in allowed egress pool)
[11:04:13] mark unhealthy backend eu-west-1a
[11:04:14] route fallback -> us-east-1
```

raj: that suggests NAT egress pool change happened before LB/route reconciler noticed new mapping. We should check the reconciliation window for egress-ip -> region mapping.
oliver: possible fixes: (A) widen allowed egress range during transitions, (B) make LB health checks ignore source IP for a warmup window, or (C) make geo-dns fallback wait longer/require multiple failures.
emma: short-term mitigation: revert NAT pool change or add the new egress prefixes to LB allowlist. Rolling revert would be fastest.
sophia: can infra-bot confirm what changed at 11:00? @infra-bot what was deployed in nat-config service at 11:00?
infra-bot: Deployment event: nat-config v3.8.2 deployed by infra-ci at 2026-03-18T11:00:07Z. Change: egress-pool rotation policy enabled (max_shift=1).
raj: rotation policy probably moved some instances to new egress IPs. We need to coordinate rotation with LB allowlist updates.
oliver: also we should patch the fallback policy: require 2 consecutive route-level health failures before global fallback, and honor region-pin longer (configurable grace period).
emma: agree. action items: (1) revert nat-config rotation (emma), (2) add new prefixes to LB allowlist (raj), (3) PR to change fallback policy to require 2 failures and 60s pin grace (sophia).
raj: I'll add a short postmortem note in incidents channel after we stabilize.
sophia: quick test plan: simulate egress rotation in staging + verify LB healthcheck behavior and that geo-dns pin holds.
emma: doing revert now, ping when LB allowlist updated. :thumbsup:
oliver: thanks, team. once stable let's add an automated check: when egress IPs change, emit an alert if LB allowlist doesn't include them.
emma: noted. will follow up with a tiny runbook for oncall.
raj: thanks, rolling this out now.
